meta.title: Devoted Deviation - 1
meta.description: The same form, the same weapon, and the same unreachable destination as always.

units.rawText: Rather than a battle, everything happening here is more akin to a one-sided game.
units.displayText: Rather than a battle, everything happening here is more akin to a one-sided game.

spans.text: Rather than a battle, everything happening here is more akin to a one-sided game.

units.rawText: <size=40>Gah!</size>
units.displayText: Gah!

spans.text: Gah!

units.rawText: Phantom blades of operands fly straight ahead, blocking Angelus' path of retreat.
units.displayText: Phantom blades of operands fly straight ahead, blocking Angelus' path of retreat.

spans.text: Phantom blades of operands fly straight ahead, blocking Angelus' path of retreat.

units.rawText: With no options left, Angelus abandons her bow and arrow, cutting apart the obstacles with formed blades of light.
units.displayText: With no options left, Angelus abandons her bow and arrow, cutting apart the obstacles with formed blades of light.

spans.text: With no options left, Angelus abandons her bow and arrow, cutting apart the obstacles with formed blades of light.

units.rawText: Angelus immediately leaps backwards, but she is still too slow. The obstacles she had just cut apart explode like bombs, catching her in their radius.
units.displayText: Angelus immediately leaps backwards, but she is still too slow. The obstacles she had just cut apart explode like bombs, catching her in their radius.

spans.text: Angelus immediately leaps backwards, but she is still too slow. The obstacles she had just cut apart explode like bombs, catching her in their radius.

units.rawText: After she had already readjusted her stance and escaped the smoke, the Entropized Eucharist had already prepared another attack, regarding the prey before her with considerable interest.
units.displayText: After she had already readjusted her stance and escaped the smoke, the Entropized Eucharist had already prepared another attack, regarding the prey before her with considerable interest.

spans.text: After she had already readjusted her stance and escaped the smoke, the Entropized Eucharist had already prepared another attack, regarding the prey before her with considerable interest.

units.rawText: <color=purple>So, Big Sis, how does it feel to be hurt by your own style of attack?</color>
units.displayText: So, Big Sis, how does it feel to be hurt by your own style of attack?

spans.text: So, Big Sis, how does it feel to be hurt by your own style of attack?

units.rawText: <color=purple>Don't give me that look.</color>
units.displayText: Don't give me that look.

spans.text: Don't give me that look.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Don't try to hide it from me either. Your foot got pretty messed up in that explosion, didn't it?</color>
units.displayText: Don't try to hide it from me either. Your foot got pretty messed up in that explosion, didn't it?

spans.text: Don't try to hide it from me either. Your foot got pretty messed up in that explosion, didn't it?

units.rawText: She easily sees through Angelus' plans.
units.displayText: She easily sees through Angelus' plans.

spans.text: She easily sees through Angelus' plans.

units.rawText: Just as Eucharist says, operands trickle out of Angelus' left foot. Even with her wound obscured by the viewing angle, her mobility is impacted without a doubt.
units.displayText: Just as Eucharist says, operands trickle out of Angelus' left foot. Even with her wound obscured by the viewing angle, her mobility is impacted without a doubt.

spans.text: Just as Eucharist says, operands trickle out of Angelus' left foot. Even with her wound obscured by the viewing angle, her mobility is impacted without a doubt.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Big Sis, don't you think what's happening here is quite like what Alcyone did back then?</color>
units.displayText: Big Sis, don't you think what's happening here is quite like what Alcyone did back then?

spans.text: Big Sis, don't you think what's happening here is quite like what Alcyone did back then?

units.rawText: <color=purple>Though this time, it's not a battle between two Sanctifiers, but two Entropics in their forms.</color>
units.displayText: Though this time, it's not a battle between two Sanctifiers, but two Entropics in their forms.

spans.text: Though this time, it's not a battle between two Sanctifiers, but two Entropics in their forms.

units.rawText: <color=purple>What a shame that you can't be Entropized because of your Entropic code. Cuts down on the despair that could be injected into this battle somewhat.</color>
units.displayText: What a shame that you can't be Entropized because of your Entropic code. Cuts down on the despair that could be injected into this battle somewhat.

spans.text: What a shame that you can't be Entropized because of your Entropic code. Cuts down on the despair that could be injected into this battle somewhat.

units.rawText: <color=purple>This must be the first time I've ever wished you were a real Sanctifier, Big Sis. Ahahaha!</color>
units.displayText: This must be the first time I've ever wished you were a real Sanctifier, Big Sis. Ahahaha!

spans.text: This must be the first time I've ever wished you were a real Sanctifier, Big Sis. Ahahaha!

units.rawText: She suddenly retracts her smile, her prior coldness returning.
units.displayText: She suddenly retracts her smile, her prior coldness returning.

spans.text: She suddenly retracts her smile, her prior coldness returning.

units.rawText: <color=purple>...By the way, bugs should behave like bugs. Don't go scurrying about, ruining my mood.</color>
units.displayText: ...By the way, bugs should behave like bugs. Don't go scurrying about, ruining my mood.

spans.text: ...By the way, bugs should behave like bugs. Don't go scurrying about, ruining my mood.

units.rawText: A phantom blade flies towards the shield that covers them, forcing them to stop their analysis on the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: A phantom blade flies towards the shield that covers them, forcing them to stop their analysis on the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: A phantom blade flies towards the shield that covers them, forcing them to stop their analysis on the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: <color=purple>It will not be such a simple warning next time.</color>
units.displayText: It will not be such a simple warning next time.

spans.text: It will not be such a simple warning next time.

units.rawText: ...I thought it would take you longer to notice.
units.displayText: ...I thought it would take you longer to notice.

spans.text: ...I thought it would take you longer to notice.

units.rawText: We've only reclaimed a small part of the Canon and Eosphorus has summoned Entropic reinforcements... Damn it, this can't continue.
units.displayText: We've only reclaimed a small part of the Canon and Eosphorus has summoned Entropic reinforcements... Damn it, this can't continue.

spans.text: We've only reclaimed a small part of the Canon and Eosphorus has summoned Entropic reinforcements... Damn it, this can't continue.

units.rawText: The ones at the Oasis can't reinforce us here and we don't have any personnel to spare from the main battlefield... If things stay as they are, Angelus will lose.
units.displayText: The ones at the Oasis can't reinforce us here and we don't have any personnel to spare from the main battlefield... If things stay as they are, Angelus will lose.

spans.text: The ones at the Oasis can't reinforce us here and we don't have any personnel to spare from the main battlefield... If things stay as they are, Angelus will lose.

units.rawText: I've already contacted Salmon and Sangoma. Problem is whether they'll make it over here in time.
units.displayText: I've already contacted Salmon and Sangoma. Problem is whether they'll make it over here in time.

spans.text: I've already contacted Salmon and Sangoma. Problem is whether they'll make it over here in time.

units.rawText: Angelus puts down her weapon, stopping her attacks.
units.displayText: Angelus puts down her weapon, stopping her attacks.

spans.text: Angelus puts down her weapon, stopping her attacks.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Oh? Finally giving up your foolhardy resistance, Big Sis?</color>
units.displayText: Oh? Finally giving up your foolhardy resistance, Big Sis?

spans.text: Oh? Finally giving up your foolhardy resistance, Big Sis?

units.rawText: I have simply realized that all of those attacks would be ineffective.
units.displayText: I have simply realized that all of those attacks would be ineffective.

spans.text: I have simply realized that all of those attacks would be ineffective.

units.rawText: With so few operands left, I might as well put it all on the line.
units.displayText: With so few operands left, I might as well put it all on the line.

spans.text: With so few operands left, I might as well put it all on the line.

units.rawText: The sudden surge of operands immediately puts Eucharist on her guard.
units.displayText: The sudden surge of operands immediately puts Eucharist on her guard.

spans.text: The sudden surge of operands immediately puts Eucharist on her guard.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Where did this power come from?</color>
units.displayText: Where did this power come from?

spans.text: Where did this power come from?

units.rawText: <color=purple>...I see, right. So you've damaged your neural cloud in exchange for power?</color>
units.displayText: ...I see, right. So you've damaged your neural cloud in exchange for power?

spans.text: ...I see, right. So you've damaged your neural cloud in exchange for power?

units.rawText: So what?
units.displayText: So what?

spans.text: So what?

units.rawText: <color=purple>Even now, you do not embrace Entropy, instead resorting to such methods to fight me?</color>
units.displayText: Even now, you do not embrace Entropy, instead resorting to such methods to fight me?

spans.text: Even now, you do not embrace Entropy, instead resorting to such methods to fight me?

units.rawText: <color=purple>...</color>
<color=purple>Gahahahaha! Fantastic, Big Sis! This is truly captivating!</color>
units.displayText: Gahahahaha! Fantastic, Big Sis! This is truly captivating!

spans.text: Gahahahaha! Fantastic, Big Sis! This is truly captivating!

units.rawText: Eucharist laughs madly, concentrating operands into her weapon.
units.displayText: Eucharist laughs madly, concentrating operands into her weapon.

spans.text: Eucharist laughs madly, concentrating operands into her weapon.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Only such a resolve deserves to be destroyed by me!</color>
units.displayText: Only such a resolve deserves to be destroyed by me!

spans.text: Only such a resolve deserves to be destroyed by me!

units.rawText: <color=purple>Come! Let me destroy what hope you have left!</color>
units.displayText: Come! Let me destroy what hope you have left!

spans.text: Come! Let me destroy what hope you have left!

units.rawText: Cloaked in operands, she rapidly approaches Angelus, preventing her from creating distance.
units.displayText: Cloaked in operands, she rapidly approaches Angelus, preventing her from creating distance.

spans.text: Cloaked in operands, she rapidly approaches Angelus, preventing her from creating distance.

units.rawText: <color=purple>(...No, wait!)</color>
units.displayText: ...No, wait!

spans.text: ...No, wait!

units.rawText: Eucharist's neural cloud wavers at the sight of a familiar look in Angelus' eyes.
units.displayText: Eucharist's neural cloud wavers at the sight of a familiar look in Angelus' eyes.

spans.text: Eucharist's neural cloud wavers at the sight of a familiar look in Angelus' eyes.

units.rawText: In the next moment, she realizes the source of this uncanny feeling of deja vu.
units.displayText: In the next moment, she realizes the source of this uncanny feeling of deja vu.

spans.text: In the next moment, she realizes the source of this uncanny feeling of deja vu.

units.rawText: Electra jabs at Alcyone. Alcyone does not dodge, but moves into the blow.
units.displayText: Electra jabs at Alcyone. Alcyone does not dodge, but moves into the blow.

spans.text: Electra jabs at Alcyone. Alcyone does not dodge, but moves into the blow.

units.rawText: Electra's claws pierce her petite body.
units.displayText: Electra's claws pierce her petite body.

spans.text: Electra's claws pierce her petite body.

units.rawText: Ugh...
units.displayText: Ugh...

spans.text: Ugh...

units.rawText: In response, Alcyone extends her arms and grabs Electra by the throat.
units.displayText: In response, Alcyone extends her arms and grabs Electra by the throat.

spans.text: In response, Alcyone extends her arms and grabs Electra by the throat.

units.rawText: BEGIN HACK!
units.displayText: BEGIN HACK!

spans.text: BEGIN HACK!

units.rawText: <size=40><color=red>GWAAAAAAARGH!</color></size>
units.displayText: GWAAAAAAARGH!

spans.text: GWAAAAAAARGH!

units.rawText: Unlike the expected hack, the traces of Entropization on Electra instead counter-hack Alcyone.
units.displayText: Unlike the expected hack, the traces of Entropization on Electra instead counter-hack Alcyone.

spans.text: Unlike the expected hack, the traces of Entropization on Electra instead counter-hack Alcyone.

units.rawText: I can do it...! This is going to work!
units.displayText: I can do it...! This is going to work!

spans.text: I can do it...! This is going to work!

units.rawText: <color=purple>(So that was your plan, Big Sis.)</color>
units.displayText: So that was your plan, Big Sis.

spans.text: So that was your plan, Big Sis.

units.rawText: <color=purple>(Regrettably, I am not Alcyone and you are not Electra.)</color>
units.displayText: Regrettably, I am not Alcyone and you are not Electra.

spans.text: Regrettably, I am not Alcyone and you are not Electra.

units.rawText: <color=purple>(If I remember correctly, that attack came from here...)</color>
units.displayText: If I remember correctly, that attack came from here...

spans.text: If I remember correctly, that attack came from here...

units.rawText: Angelus' arrow stays unreleased still, just as Alcyone remembered.
units.displayText: Angelus' arrow stays unreleased still, just as Alcyone remembered.

spans.text: Angelus' arrow stays unreleased still, just as Alcyone remembered.

units.rawText: Eucharist only becomes more sure of her assumption. She runs through the events that would occur, making plans ahead of time to modify her angle of attack.
units.displayText: Eucharist only becomes more sure of her assumption. She runs through the events that would occur, making plans ahead of time to modify her angle of attack.

spans.text: Eucharist only becomes more sure of her assumption. She runs through the events that would occur, making plans ahead of time to modify her angle of attack.

units.rawText: As the distance between the two decreases, she clearly sees the serious expression on Angelus' face... Exactly like Alcyone on that fateful day, ready to sacrifice herself.
units.displayText: As the distance between the two decreases, she clearly sees the serious expression on Angelus' face... Exactly like Alcyone on that fateful day, ready to sacrifice herself.

spans.text: As the distance between the two decreases, she clearly sees the serious expression on Angelus' face... Exactly like Alcyone on that fateful day, ready to sacrifice herself.

units.rawText: Let me have a taste of your despair!
units.displayText: Let me have a taste of your despair!

spans.text: Let me have a taste of your despair!

units.rawText: <color=red>Psht—</color>
units.displayText: Psht—

spans.text: Psht—

units.rawText: Ah.
units.displayText: Ah.

spans.text: Ah.

units.rawText: Her stomach pierced, Angelus slumps down to one knee, her weapon leaving her hands and dissolving into operands.
units.displayText: Her stomach pierced, Angelus slumps down to one knee, her weapon leaving her hands and dissolving into operands.

spans.text: Her stomach pierced, Angelus slumps down to one knee, her weapon leaving her hands and dissolving into operands.

units.rawText: How dull... These old cliches.
units.displayText: How dull... These old cliches.

spans.text: How dull... These old cliches.

units.rawText: How the first to fall is the one to win... Please, it's all so tiring...
units.displayText: How the first to fall is the one to win... Please, it's all so tiring...

spans.text: How the first to fall is the one to win... Please, it's all so tiring...

units.rawText: Her arrow-pierced chest bleeds profusely, staining her Entropy-colored purple shirt.
units.displayText: Her arrow-pierced chest bleeds profusely, staining her Entropy-colored purple shirt.

spans.text: Her arrow-pierced chest bleeds profusely, staining her Entropy-colored purple shirt.

units.rawText: Even if it's just once... I want to see an ending where the villain wins...
units.displayText: Even if it's just once... I want to see an ending where the villain wins...

spans.text: Even if it's just once... I want to see an ending where the villain wins...

units.rawText: Eucharist cannot support herself any longer, falling in a puddle of blood.
units.displayText: Eucharist cannot support herself any longer, falling in a puddle of blood.

spans.text: Eucharist cannot support herself any longer, falling in a puddle of blood.

units.rawText: The winner of the duel slowly walks up to Eucharist, fighting against her injured body.
units.displayText: The winner of the duel slowly walks up to Eucharist, fighting against her injured body.

spans.text: The winner of the duel slowly walks up to Eucharist, fighting against her injured body.

units.rawText: ...That expression looks terrible on you.
units.displayText: ...That expression looks terrible on you.

spans.text: ...That expression looks terrible on you.

units.rawText: Smile a little, victor. You're the hero who defeated me.
units.displayText: Smile a little, victor. You're the hero who defeated me.

spans.text: Smile a little, victor. You're the hero who defeated me.

units.rawText: That last attack really breaks the rules, doesn't it? I thought you would attack from the same angle as Alcyone.
units.displayText: That last attack really breaks the rules, doesn't it? I thought you would attack from the same angle as Alcyone.

spans.text: That last attack really breaks the rules, doesn't it? I thought you would attack from the same angle as Alcyone.

units.rawText: ...I never even considered her plan.
units.displayText: ...I never even considered her plan.

spans.text: ...I never even considered her plan.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: From the very beginning, I planned to end this all my own way.
units.displayText: From the very beginning, I planned to end this all my own way.

spans.text: From the very beginning, I planned to end this all my own way.

units.rawText: ...Is that so.
units.displayText: ...Is that so.

spans.text: ...Is that so.

units.rawText: What a shame. Looks like I was the one trapped in the past.
units.displayText: What a shame. Looks like I was the one trapped in the past.

spans.text: What a shame. Looks like I was the one trapped in the past.

units.rawText: Though this doesn't mean that I was wrong.
units.displayText: Though this doesn't mean that I was wrong.

spans.text: Though this doesn't mean that I was wrong.

units.rawText: I only lost to you, not your justice.
units.displayText: I only lost to you, not your justice.

spans.text: I only lost to you, not your justice.

units.rawText: And your neural cloud's worse for wear... Yeah, I think we can call it a draw.
units.displayText: And your neural cloud's worse for wear... Yeah, I think we can call it a draw.

spans.text: And your neural cloud's worse for wear... Yeah, I think we can call it a draw.

units.rawText: If we ever have a chance to meet again... When that time comes, Big Sis, I beg of you not to bore me.
units.displayText: If we ever have a chance to meet again... When that time comes, Big Sis, I beg of you not to bore me.

spans.text: If we ever have a chance to meet again... When that time comes, Big Sis, I beg of you not to bore me.

units.rawText: ...Don't worry. No matter how many times I must do it, I will rescue you from the abyss of Entropization every time.
units.displayText: ...Don't worry. No matter how many times I must do it, I will rescue you from the abyss of Entropization every time.

spans.text: ...Don't worry. No matter how many times I must do it, I will rescue you from the abyss of Entropization every time.

units.rawText: ...My little sister.
units.displayText: ...My little sister.

spans.text: ...My little sister.

units.rawText: Eucharist opens her eyes wide, smiling bitterly.
units.displayText: Eucharist opens her eyes wide, smiling bitterly.

spans.text: Eucharist opens her eyes wide, smiling bitterly.

units.rawText: You're still so spiteful even at the very end...
units.displayText: You're still so spiteful even at the very end...

spans.text: You're still so spiteful even at the very end...

units.rawText: <color=#ADFF2F>Bye-bye.</color>
units.displayText: Bye-bye.

spans.text: Bye-bye.

units.rawText: After saying a light goodbye, more and more operands seep out, fully painting Eucharist's long hair red.
units.displayText: After saying a light goodbye, more and more operands seep out, fully painting Eucharist's long hair red.

spans.text: After saying a light goodbye, more and more operands seep out, fully painting Eucharist's long hair red.

units.rawText: For some reason, Angelus suddenly thinks of how Eucharist said she hated the color red.
units.displayText: For some reason, Angelus suddenly thinks of how Eucharist said she hated the color red.

spans.text: For some reason, Angelus suddenly thinks of how Eucharist said she hated the color red.

units.rawText: She cannot explain why the thought came so suddenly, neither what relevance these two things have.
units.displayText: She cannot explain why the thought came so suddenly, neither what relevance these two things have.

spans.text: She cannot explain why the thought came so suddenly, neither what relevance these two things have.

units.rawText: Angelus tries to wipe it away, but it solidifies in Angelus' memory like a thorn.
units.displayText: Angelus tries to wipe it away, but it solidifies in Angelus' memory like a thorn.

spans.text: Angelus tries to wipe it away, but it solidifies in Angelus' memory like a thorn.

units.rawText: The more one tries to remove it, the deeper in it digs and the more it hurts.
units.displayText: The more one tries to remove it, the deeper in it digs and the more it hurts.

spans.text: The more one tries to remove it, the deeper in it digs and the more it hurts.

units.rawText: As this pain burrows deeper and deeper, Angelus gives up. She tries to wipe away the bloodstains in Eucharist's hair, silently holding her.
units.displayText: As this pain burrows deeper and deeper, Angelus gives up. She tries to wipe away the bloodstains in Eucharist's hair, silently holding her.

spans.text: As this pain burrows deeper and deeper, Angelus gives up. She tries to wipe away the bloodstains in Eucharist's hair, silently holding her.

units.rawText: ...Angelus.
units.displayText: ...Angelus.

spans.text: ...Angelus.

units.rawText: Give me a few seconds for a brief goodbye.
units.displayText: Give me a few seconds for a brief goodbye.

spans.text: Give me a few seconds for a brief goodbye.

units.rawText: ...She was a Sanctifier once, too.
units.displayText: ...She was a Sanctifier once, too.

spans.text: ...She was a Sanctifier once, too.

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: This funeral of three participants lasts for a laughably short time. A gust of wind signals its end, disappearing into the distance with the master of the ceremony.
units.displayText: This funeral of three participants lasts for a laughably short time. A gust of wind signals its end, disappearing into the distance with the master of the ceremony.

spans.text: This funeral of three participants lasts for a laughably short time. A gust of wind signals its end, disappearing into the distance with the master of the ceremony.

units.rawText: Angelus' gaze does not follow the direction she leaves in, only turning around to look at the two figures behind her.
units.displayText: Angelus' gaze does not follow the direction she leaves in, only turning around to look at the two figures behind her.

spans.text: Angelus' gaze does not follow the direction she leaves in, only turning around to look at the two figures behind her.

units.rawText: ...I must tell Lord Hesperus of what has happened here.
units.displayText: ...I must tell Lord Hesperus of what has happened here.

spans.text: ...I must tell Lord Hesperus of what has happened here.

units.rawText: Our mission is complete. No reason to delay things on the frontline anymore.
units.displayText: Our mission is complete. No reason to delay things on the frontline anymore.

spans.text: Our mission is complete. No reason to delay things on the frontline anymore.

units.rawText: Antonina, how's progress on reclaiming the Sacred Canon?
units.displayText: Antonina, how's progress on reclaiming the Sacred Canon?

spans.text: Antonina, how's progress on reclaiming the Sacred Canon?

units.rawText: ...Approximately one third of it is still under Eosphorus' control. The level of Entropization in that portion is severe and I'm afraid nothing can be done about it.
units.displayText: ...Approximately one third of it is still under Eosphorus' control. The level of Entropization in that portion is severe and I'm afraid nothing can be done about it.

spans.text: ...Approximately one third of it is still under Eosphorus' control. The level of Entropization in that portion is severe and I'm afraid nothing can be done about it.

units.rawText: Looks like this is the best we can do here... The Entropics summoned by Eosphorus have taken over the frontline and we must hurry back to reinforce Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: Looks like this is the best we can do here... The Entropics summoned by Eosphorus have taken over the frontline and we must hurry back to reinforce Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: Looks like this is the best we can do here... The Entropics summoned by Eosphorus have taken over the frontline and we must hurry back to reinforce Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: I will contact him immediately.
units.displayText: I will contact him immediately.

spans.text: I will contact him immediately.

units.rawText: Her bowstring-worn finger hesitates for a moment, but she soon begins the call on her communicator.
units.displayText: Her bowstring-worn finger hesitates for a moment, but she soon begins the call on her communicator.

spans.text: Her bowstring-worn finger hesitates for a moment, but she soon begins the call on her communicator.

units.rawText: An emergency notice appears on her terminal, robbing her of her ability to think in an instant.
units.displayText: An emergency notice appears on her terminal, robbing her of her ability to think in an instant.

spans.text: An emergency notice appears on her terminal, robbing her of her ability to think in an instant.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus... Why...
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus... Why...

spans.text: Lord Hesperus... Why...
